# Party (`party` v1)

A political party: position, leader, seats, and its polling trend.

**Group:** Politics and society · **Mnemonic:** `PARTY` · **Identifiers:** `PARTY-…` in `partyId`

Open one with `PARTY <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: party
version: 1
description: "A political party: position, leader, seats, and its polling trend."
match: { kind: party, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Politics and society · Party, id: $.partyId }
strip:
  - { label: Party, bind: $.name, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Position, bind: $.position }
  - { label: Leader, bind: $.leaderName }
  - { label: Seats, bind: $.seats, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Polling, bind: $.polling, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Members, bind: $.members, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: trend
    kind: line
    title: Polling average
    key: F2
    rows: $.trend
    x: month
    y: share
    fmt: pct0
  - id: platform
    kind: kv
    title: Platform
    area: right
    rows: $.platform
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.jurisdiction, 'jurisdiction')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
